name: I Hate Myself and Want to Die

podcast.body: Oasis' "Live Forever" was written by Noel Gallagher as a direct answer to this song. Noel was annoyed by Kurt Cobain's apparent misery despite his fame, money, and talent. "He'd later say that Live Forever is supposed to be an answer to the Nirvana song I hate myself and want to die."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song by Nirvana was specifically mentioned by Noel Gallagher of Oasis, who was annoyed by its perceived gloom and pessimism. He contrasted it with Oasis's optimism, especially given Nirvana's success versus Oasis's early struggles. "Noel was particularly annoyed at Nirvana for writing a song like, I hate myself and want to die."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
